Container.Name: Lyftr-Backend
Container.Overview: Lyftr is a workout and nutrition tracker: programs built from an 800+ exercise library, set-by-set logging with a rest timer, a calorie and macro diary with barcode scanning (Open Food Facts), and a bodyweight log.[br][br]This is the API server. It stores everything in one SQLite file in the appdata folder. Install it first, then install the Lyftr template (the web UI) and point it at this container's IP and port.[br][br]JWT_SECRET is required: generate one with openssl rand -hex 32 and keep it unchanged across updates. Registration is first-user: only the first account can sign up, then sign-up closes. To let someone else join, edit this container, set REGISTRATION to open, and set it back to first-user once they have an account.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: fitness workout gym nutrition calories weight tracker
Container.Requires: Install together with the Lyftr template (the web UI). Internet access for the exercise catalog download and food search.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Port the Lyftr web UI container proxies /api to. Enter this host port, with the server's IP, in the Lyftr template.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (lyftr.db). Back this folder up before updating.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. Random string of 32+ characters that signs sign-in tokens, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION
Config.Description: Who may create an account. first-user: only the first account can sign up, then sign-up closes. open: anyone who can reach the server. closed: nobody.

Config.Name: CORS_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API from another host. Not needed when the web UI is opened through the Lyftr container.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the server listens on inside the container.

Config.Name: DEMO_MODE
Config.Description: Seeds a demo account whose password is public. Leave false.
